The following events took place in '''1040 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*Fragmentation of the [[Chagras Hegemony]].
*Initiation of the [[Second Charge Matrica|Second ''Charge Matrica'']].
*[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Saaj Calician]] meets [[Quillan (Sith)|Quillan]] and [[Dromika]] and becomes the [[Regent/Legends|Regent]] of the [[Dyarchy]].
*Saaj Calician orders the capture of [[One (Celegian)|One]] and his transportation to [[The Loft]] on [[Byllura]].

==Deaths==
*[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Chagras]]
